title: grover-tax fixture v0.1
description: Schema for fixtures/v0.1.json — the canonical input shared by both provers. See docs/spec/03-data-model.md §'Fixture' for the F-INV-1..9 invariants.

version.description: Fixture-format version. Frozen at 'v0.1' for the entire v0.1.x series (F-INV-7).

generator_commit.description: Repo SHA at the time gen_fixtures.py produced this file. Excluded from --check normalisation.

workload_pin_commit.description: Upstream zkp_ecc SHA recorded in WORKLOAD.md frontmatter at generation time.

n_samples.description: Number of test cases. Must equal len(test_cases) (F-INV-1).

bit_stripe_width.description: Reversible-circuit bit-stripe width W from WORKLOAD.md.

circuit_serialisation_format_version.description: Canonical serialisation format version (F-INV-6). v0.1 freezes this at 1.

circuit_byte_serialisation_hex.description: Canonical byte serialisation of gate-list C, lowercase hex, even length (F-INV-8).

circuit_commitment_blake2s_hex.description: blake2s(bytes.fromhex(circuit_byte_serialisation_hex)) — 32-byte digest, no personalisation. Verified by F-INV-3.

test_cases.description: Ordered list of (P,Q,R) tuples; iteration order is binding (F-INV-9).

x_hex.description: Encoded secp256k1 inputs (a pair of points) per docs/spec/03-data-model.md §'Fixture'. Length is fixed at 128 lowercase-hex characters by the table in the data-model spec.

y_hex.description: Encoded secp256k1 output (one compressed-affine point) per docs/spec/03-data-model.md §'Fixture'. Length is fixed at 66 lowercase-hex characters.
